title: kube play: Close file handles for ConfigMaps and Secrets before pod executes.
body:
When running a container in a pod using `podman kube play`, if your command immediately executes a script file, you will get an ETXTBSY error because the file handle is still open until after playKubePod returns, since all the closes are deferred. This replaces the defer with explicit file.Close() calls where the file handle stops being used, so configmaps that are executable can actually be executed when the pod is created.
